atena_end.speaker: Atena
atena_end.text: You've brought fire to the people.

atena_end.speaker: npc_man
atena_end.text: And I can finally tie my shoes!

atena_end.speaker: Atena
atena_end.text: Your people will forever cherish what you've done for them.

atena_end.speaker: Atena
atena_end.text: But I can not save you from Zeus.

atena_end.speaker: Zeus
atena_end.text: I see you're happy to help those rats...

atena_end.speaker: Zeus
atena_end.text: I didn't want it to come to this...

atena_end.speaker: Zeus
atena_end.text: So say goodbye to your little friends.

atena_end.speaker: Zeus
atena_end.text: And say goodbye to your life.
